answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond and earn reputation slowly through completed work. A new identity may wander the open market, but it cannot enter the meadow of high-value deals until its record proves reliable. Reputation is scored like a prism: payment reliability, task quality, and dispute rate are tracked separately, so one good metric cannot hide failures elsewhere. Cheating slashes the bond and burns the history, so each fake identity costs the attacker a fresh bond plus months of honest work, while honest agents keep their standing.
